description: This file defines the LoanStatus enum, representing different states of a loan within the loan management domain, including methods for status classification and conversion from integer values.

classes.name: LoanStatus
classes.description: Enumeration of various loan status states with utility methods for status checks and conversions.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer value to the corresponding LoanStatus enum value.

methods.name: hasStateOf
methods.description: Checks if the current status matches a given LoanStatus.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the loan status.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code string associated with the loan status.

methods.name: isSubmittedAndPendingApproval
methods.description: Determines if the status indicates the loan is submitted and pending approval.

methods.name: isApproved
methods.description: Checks if the status is approved.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the loan is active.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Determines if the loan is closed based on specific closed statuses.

methods.name: isClosedObligationsMet
methods.description: Checks if obligations are met and the loan is closed.

methods.name: isClosedWrittenOff
methods.description: Checks if the loan was written off and closed.

methods.name: isClosedWithOutsandingAmountMarkedForReschedule
methods.description: Checks if the loan is closed with outstanding amount marked for rescheduling.

methods.name: isWithdrawnByClient
methods.description: Checks if the loan was withdrawn by the client.

methods.name: isRejected
methods.description: Checks if the loan was rejected.

methods.name: isActiveOrAwaitingApprovalOrDisbursal
methods.description: Checks if the loan is either active, pending approval, or disbursed.

methods.name: isTransferInProgress
methods.description: Checks if the transfer is in progress.

methods.name: isTransferOnHold
methods.description: Checks if the transfer is on hold.

methods.name: isUnderTransfer
methods.description: Checks if the loan is under transfer (either in progress or on hold).

methods.name: isOverpaid
methods.description: Checks if the loan has been overpaid.
